question: For the customer who made a transaction of exactly 548.4 on '2012-08-24', calculate the difference in total gas consumption between CZK-paying and EUR-paying customers within the same client segment as this customer during 2012.

prediction.sql:
WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT c.XCL_002 AS segment
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    WHERE t.XCL_018 = 548.4
      AND t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-24'
)
SELECT 
    SUM(IIF(c.XCL_003 = 'CZK', y.XCL_021, 0)) - 
    SUM(IIF(c.XCL_003 = 'EUR', y.XCL_021, 0)) AS difference
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN yearmonth y ON c.XCL_001 = y.XCL_019
INNER JOIN target_customer tc ON c.XCL_002 = tc.segment
WHERE SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012'

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_013 AS customer_id,
        c.XCL_003 AS client_segment
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE t.XCL_018 = 548.4
      AND t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-24'
),
segment_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        tc.customer_id,
        tc.client_segment
    FROM target_customer tc
),
gas_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        sc.client_segment,
        t.XCL_012 AS currency,
        SUM(t.XCL_015) AS total_gas
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN segment_customers sc ON t.XCL_013 = sc.customer_id
    WHERE t.XCL_011 >= '2012-01-01' AND t.XCL_011 < '2013-01-01'
    GROUP BY sc.client_segment, t.XCL_012
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN total_gas ELSE 0 END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN total_gas ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM gas_consumption
